marketing.title: Science, art and shared wonder
marketing.draft_copy: Join 80 adults for Science, art and shared wonder at Banksia Hall, with a quiet-space pause in the Paperbark Quiet Room. The draft programme includes welcome and wayfinding, short science talks, an art and observation workshop in Banksia Hall, and light refreshments and conversation. Setup and pack-down fit within the 18:00–21:00 venue booking.

assumptions: This is a fictional, local drafting fixture; no availability or cost is a real quote.
